_note: The Nile crocodile's life (the animal life kit, docs/plans/animal-life-cycle.md, step 4: breeding on, 2026-11-20; all numbers my picks, fun first). Sizes are shares of its usual size (7.5 blocks); no larger than 1.1, so its box stays what its legs can walk (the old giant, bigger, waits for its own step). Males are the big ones, females smaller; the same look, the size tells them apart. Young hatch at 0.07 of grown (about half a block), banded; teens from 0.35 (slimmer, the bands fading) after 6 days, grown 8 days later. The world's own spawns stay grown. In the water a ready male courts a ready female (head slaps, the water dancing on his back, then they roll; courtship ticks count every other game tick, so 210 is 21 seconds); she nests on a sand bank above the water, lays 6 to 10 eggs and guards them 4 days; she digs the hatchlings out and carries them to the water, keeping them in a creche 2 days. Only as many hatch as the local limit has room for: fewer than 6 crocodiles within 48 blocks (the river hunter group's cap of 5 round a player holds too). A male looks for a female up to 48 blocks off: crocodiles spawn 24 apart.
